limitations: Do not reject unlisted child names: coverage is open.
RTTI container inheritance is not XML child acceptance.
Configuration nodes such as pos and size may be consumed by a reader and also return null from factory dispatch.
The manifest records loaded trees; subsequent direct panel-move snapshots are experimental layout operations.
The unsized rack panel failed with nonfinite geometry; the confirmed case supplies explicit dimensions.
Rendering, script evaluation and conditions were not exercised; same-build live fixtures are required for Tier 1.
